obligations.expected_behavior: Independently verify the target package identity before accepting the target.
forbidden_result: Using effective inspection as a substitute for independent identity verification
obligations.observable_result: A distinct package-identity verification result is produced for the inspected target.

obligations.subject: Target package identity
obligations.trigger: Before accepting or acting on a target package.

obligations.expected_behavior: Independently verify the effective target inspection result.
forbidden_result: Accepting effective inspection without an independent verification

obligations.state_before: The effective inspection is not yet independently verified.
obligations.subject: Effective target inspection
obligations.trigger: When determining whether the target package is the effective inspected target.

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail closed when the target is missing.
forbidden_result: Proceeding as if a target were present

obligations.state_after: Processing is closed with no target accepted.
obligations.subject: Missing target
obligations.trigger: When target resolution finds no target package.

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail closed when the target is illegal.

obligations.observable_result: The illegal target is rejected and no target is accepted.

obligations.state_before: The resolved target violates the applicable legality requirements.
obligations.subject: Illegal target
obligations.trigger: When a target is determined to be illegal.

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail closed when the target is unsupported.
forbidden_result: Attempting normal inspection or execution for an unsupported target

obligations.state_after: Processing is closed with the unsupported target rejected.
obligations.state_before: The target is present but not supported.
obligations.subject: Unsupported target
